title: ricinocarpus carthagenensis
intro: Ricinocarpus carthagenensis, commonly known as Spanish Needles, is a plant species belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as skin conditions, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Ricinocarpus carthagenensis are attributed to its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
